newsitem.title: MEXICO: Seven main ports shut in Mexico due to bad weather.
newsitem.headline: Seven main ports shut in Mexico due to bad weather.

text.p: Seven main Gulf of Mexico ports stretching from Tuxpan in the eastern state of Veracruz to Campeche in the southeast were closed Monday due to bad weather, the Communications and Transport Ministry said.
In a bulletin, the ministry said the ports of Tuxpan, Veracruz, Coatzacoalcos, Dos. Bocas, Frontera, Ciudad Carmen and Campeche were closed as of 6 p.m. (2300 GMT).

In a separate statement, it said 11 other smaller ports in the same region were shut as of midday Monday. The ports were affected by strong winds and rough seas because of the passing of tropical storm Josefina, the ministry said.
"For reasons of precaution, the sailing of cargo, oil, fishing, tourist and recreative ships was restricted," the ministry said.

It said Josefina was expected to weaken as the storm hit the northeast coast of Florida sometime overnight. At 4 p.m. (2100 GMT) it was 51 miles south-southeast of Apalachicola, Florida, moving northeast at 20 knots, with maximum sustained windspeeds of 60 knots.
